overloads.semanticRole: The WEB SEND BLOB command allows you to send blob to the browser.

constraints: type selects how the browser interprets blob: an empty string "" lets the browser guess from content; a file extension (e.g. ".HTM", ".GIF") sets the MIME type by extension, which must be a standard/registered one; a full MIME string (e.g. "text/html", or a custom "application/x-TypeName") sets the MIME type directly and lets the client browser be configured to launch an associated application for custom types.
